messages.content: How to save game progress at stage 7 in easy mode and stage 3 in hard mode?

function.name: game_save_progress

stage.description: The current stage in the game the player has reached.

mode.description: The game mode. Available modes are easy or hard.

So we should call it with stage=7, mode="easy". And second call with stage=3, mode="hard". The level defaults to "user" if omitted. The user didn't specify level, so we can omit or set default. We'll call twice.

We need to produce calls to the function via the "functions" tool. According to guidelines, we should output JSON with name and arguments. For each call, we need separate messages? We might need to do them sequentially. Usually we can do multiple calls by sending separate messages. So first call: name: "game_save_progress", arguments: {stage: 7, mode: "easy"}; second call: name: "game_save_progress", arguments: {stage: 3, mode: "hard"}.

We should not include any other text. Just the JSON calls. Probably we need to send them as separate messages. Let's do that.
